notes: infra/preview/smoke-preview.sh --media-json (ADR 0092): tusd v2.10.1 as the preview runs it (-s3-part-size and -s3-min-part-size 5 MiB, temporary parts on a volume, GOMEMLIMIT 40MiB), restarted for a fresh cgroup, then one upload of 64 MiB of random bytes in a single PATCH through the edge and the ingest gate, as the iOS background session sends (ADR 0009). memory.peak is the cgroup high-water mark, page cache of the temporary parts included; anon and memory.current sampled every 10 ms from the host.
